user.title: Sourdough Fermentation
user.description: Pick the sensors that drive the bulk fermentation estimate and set your default recipe. A dough probe (internal temperature) is the most accurate input; if set, it overrides room temperature and humidity. The recipe values below become live-editable sliders you can adjust from a dashboard before each bake.

data_description.starter_g: Defaults to 50 g → 10% inoculation at 500 g flour.
data_description.protein_pct: Higher protein lets the dough tolerate a longer bulk; it nudges the target rise rather than the fermentation rate. ~12.5% is typical strong bread flour.

init.title: Sourdough Fermentation options
init.description: Change sensors, default recipe, or the underlying model constants. Defaults are calibrated to a Tartine-style bake: 5 h bulk at 24 °C dough temp, 20% inoculation reference.

data.base_hours: Base bulk time at reference conditions (h)
